newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in after-hours trade on Friday after drifting easier during the day. Traders said the dollar's brief rise above 120 yen in late-afternoon Tokyo trade helped prices rebound.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.7 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark June was up 0.2 yen at 144.6 yen. Volume was 4,160 lots.
"In spite of the yen's fall, a lack of speculative interest due to static prices, combined with weaker overseas markets, could prevent prices from rising further," one trader said.
